geometryBasis: Named native 27-vertex outline of the main Queen Anne house and attached rear wing, oriented by the original Franklin Street centerline. The bay and porch controls are approximated within the mapped projections.
sectionBasis: Two exact May 2015 CC0 exterior views and the original HABS east-front survey photograph establish the wood gables, tower and entry. The written survey records two stories above a basement, attic, four intersecting gables, two stair runs and the connected 1929 guest wing.
